description: This file provides utility functions for splitting strings into linked list components, specifically splitting by spaces and filtering out empty tokens.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens separated by spaces and returns them as a linked list.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it is valid (not empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether the token is valid (not empty).
